title: Cosmic Wolf Goddess
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a woman with long flowing pink hair adorned with golden flowers, wearing ornate green armor, standing beside a glowing green wolf. She reaches toward a floating hamburger, french fries, and McDonald's cup orbiting a wireframe globe, flanked by two large black wolves formed from constellations against a starry cosmic background with swirling purple and green nebulae.
